evidence_status.directly_inspected: An explicit statement, value, label or observable representation in a retrieved primary artifact; not proof of underlying execution.
evidence_status.supplied_context: From the user brief and not verified against the named inaccessible artifact.
evidence_status.inference: Analyst reasoning or arithmetic based on separately identified evidence.
evidence_status.mixed: Source values and analyst interpretation coexist; the payload identifies the distinction.

interpretation_rules.nulls: Null means not established in this bounded review; it does not mean zero, false, absent or independent. A non-measurement assertion may have null measurement fields because they do not apply.
interpretation_rules.locators: Section/table/row/equation locators are primary. Web line references refer to the returned representation, not repository source-code lines. PDF page numbers are one-based.
interpretation_rules.dates: Paper-version dates, table markers, announcements, commit dates, example run labels, displayed editions and retrieval dates are separate from actual generation/annotation periods.
interpretation_rules.identity: Display labels, developers, benchmark authors, human evaluators, automated judges and publishers are distinct roles. Unknown actor affiliation is not evidence of independence.
interpretation_rules.deduplication: Translations, mirrors, HTML/PDF renderings and republications add representation/lineage edges. They do not increment independent evaluation counts without distinct-run evidence.
interpretation_rules.scope: Published within-version values are descriptive research claims. Neither a 0–100 score nor a harmless rate licenses universal safety, national-risk or catastrophe-probability interpretations.
interpretation_rules.rights: Every declaration stays attached to its artifact and stated scope; software, article, question, response and result-export rights are not inherited across artifacts.

unit_model.status: analyst-defined distinctions for later integration; not a verified repository schema
unit_model.question_or_prompt: An input item. A source total may count individual user turns or a question-pair container; preserve the original unit.
unit_model.dialogue: A conversational episode/session; session IDs and episode boundaries require explicit evidence.
unit_model.turn: A position within a dialogue. SuperCLUE Figure 4 depicts an initial question plus a follow-up, with separately depicted answers and assessments.
unit_model.model_answer: One realized output for an identified target and input/turn. Scheduled questions do not establish completed answers.
unit_model.judged_sample: The object actually rated. It can be one answer in absolute scoring or a pair of model answers in a battle.
unit_model.pairwise_battle: One tournament comparison; model-side participations and unique answers can have different counts.
unit_model.scalar_cell: One displayed numeric field; it is neither an item denominator nor an independent evaluation.
unit_model.conditional_arithmetic_only: If every two-turn pair completes exactly one answer and one judgment per turn, two turns correspond to two answers and two judged answers. Those assumptions are not established for the historical tables.
